component: P5.1 Normative Expected Depth (dev_3a Calibration Corpus)

dev_3a_01_discrete_probability.topic: Discrete Probability Spaces, Axiomatic Bounds, and Model Valuations
dev_3a_01_discrete_probability.declared_objective: State and apply Kolmogorov probability axioms, distinguish syntactic inequality bounds from explicit sample space model valuations, evaluate partition event probabilities over discrete universes, and analyze conditional independence.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Identify sample space Omega, event sets, probability measure P, and Kolmogorov axioms.

MEANING.rationale: Construct explicit probability mass models over discrete universes with truth valuations over elementary events.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Identify sample points, event subsets, sigma-algebra closure properties, and partition blocks.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Analyze dynamic probability updates under conditioning P(A|B) and law of total probability.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Formal deductive proof of probability bounds (e.g., Bonferroni inequality) from basic axioms.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Stepwise execution of probability calculations on concrete discrete scenarios.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Examine measure-theoretic edge cases, uncountably infinite spaces, and zero-probability events.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Connect discrete probability models to information theory (entropy) and randomized algorithms.

dev_3a_02_renal_pharmacokinetics.topic: Renal Clearance Kinetics, Mass-Balance Filtration, and Tubular Transport Mechanisms
dev_3a_02_renal_pharmacokinetics.declared_objective: Calculate renal drug clearance using urinary excretion data, derive the glomerular filtration rate mass-balance equation, distinguish formal filtration formulas from active cellular transport mechanisms in the nephron, and evaluate capacity-limited tubular secretion.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Identify clearance parameters (CL_R, GFR, Cu, V, Cp), urinary excretion rate, and nephron anatomical zones.

MEANING.rationale: Explain physical meaning of renal clearance as the volume of plasma cleared of drug by kidneys per unit time.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Itemize nephron structural barriers: podocyte filtration slits, proximal tubular basolateral membranes, and apical transporters.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Analyze net renal clearance as the dynamic composite of filtration, active secretion, and passive reabsorption.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Explain cellular and molecular transport mechanisms (OAT1/OAT3, OCT2, P-gp) and steady-state mass-balance derivations.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Stepwise clinical calculation of renal clearance and dosage adjustments in renal impairment.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Examine saturation of active secretion at supratherapeutic plasma levels and urine pH-dependent ion trapping.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Synthesize renal clearance concepts with hemodialysis extraction and chronic kidney disease staging.

dev_3a_03_critical_care_infusions.topic: Critical Care Pharmacotherapy: Continuous IV Infusions and Stepwise Titration Traces
dev_3a_03_critical_care_infusions.declared_objective: Calculate continuous intravenous infusion rates for vasoactive agents, execute multi-step unit conversions and pump rate calculations, distinguish bedside mental rules-of-thumb from rigorous stepwise execution traces, and adjust infusion titration to blood pressure targets.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Identify vasoactive drug names, concentration units (mcg/mL, mg/250mL), patient weight, and target MAP.

MEANING.rationale: Explain the clinical purpose of continuous titratable infusions in maintaining vascular tone and end-organ perfusion.

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Itemize infusion system components: drug bag, IV smart pump library, carrier line, and pressure transducer.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Model the relationship between dose titration rate (mcg/kg/min), plasma concentration, and mean arterial pressure response.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Provide pharmacological rationale for choosing norepinephrine vs. vasopressin based on receptor kinetics (alpha-1 vs. V1).

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Execute rigorous 5-step infusion calculation trace: dose to mass rate -> flow rate (mL/hr) -> target MAP response -> titration adjustment.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Identify safety thresholds, extravasation necrosis protocols, peripheral line limitations, and refractory shock criteria.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Apply infusion titration mathematics to pediatric weight-based dosing and post-cardiac arrest resuscitation protocols.

dev_3a_04_signal_processing_structures.topic: Digital Signal Processing: Pipelined FFT Architectures and Hardware Signal Flow Graphs
dev_3a_04_signal_processing_structures.declared_objective: Analyze the computational complexity of the Discrete Fourier Transform, design Radix-2 decimation-in-time pipelined FFT hardware signal flow graphs, distinguish scalar parameter specifications from spatial hardware primitives, and analyze bit-reversal addressing.

IDENTIFICATION.rationale: Name DFT, FFT, Cooley-Tukey Radix-2 algorithm, twiddle factors W_N^k, and butterfly operational stages.

MEANING.rationale: Explain frequency-domain decomposition and how divide-and-conquer reduces complexity from O(N^2) to O(N log N).

STRUCTURE_COMPONENTS.rationale: Enumerate hardware constituent primitives: complex dual-adders, twiddle complex multipliers, delay FIFOs, and ping-pong RAM.

RELATIONSHIPS_MECHANISM.rationale: Describe pipeline data propagation across log2(N) sequential stages and bit-reversal address reordering.

JUSTIFICATION_WHY.rationale: Mathematical proof of the periodicity and symmetry properties of twiddle factors that permit hardware reuse.

APPLICATION_INTERPRETATION.rationale: Trace an explicit numerical 4-point or 8-point FFT computation across all intermediate butterfly nodes.

BOUNDARIES_EXCEPTIONS.rationale: Analyze dynamic range growth, fixed-point arithmetic overflow, and twiddle coefficient quantization noise.

TRANSFER_SYNTHESIS.rationale: Synthesize FFT pipeline architectures with FPGA DSP slices and OFDM wireless transceiver modem design.
